targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5s'), mode AS metric, avg(latency_ms) AS value FROM jobs WHERE ok AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5s'), mode AS metric, 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN ok THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS value FROM jobs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Jobs per second by worker VM

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5s'), worker AS metric, count(*) / 5.0 AS value FROM jobs WHERE ok AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5s'), region AS metric, avg(epsilon) AS value FROM jobs WHERE mode = 'marl' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Routing share per region, last 60 s (% of that region's jobs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT region AS "Region", mode AS "Policy", round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN worker='vm-xl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "vm-xl (7)", round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN worker='vm-l' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "vm-l (5)", round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN worker='vm-m' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "vm-m (4)", round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN worker='vm-s1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "vm-s1 (2)", round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN worker='vm-s2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS "vm-s2 (2)" FROM jobs WHERE ts > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT mode, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95 FROM jobs WHERE ok AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
